title: Carrier Coverage Limit for Mold Remediation Charges
content:
On a Mold Remediation job, the coverage limit is read from the Insurance Claim Services claim file linked to the job. A job linked to a claim file in approved status whose billing arrangement accepts carrier payments issued directly to the company has a coverage limit equal to the claim file's mold sublimit; a job linked to a claim file in estimate submitted status whose billing arrangement accepts carrier payments issued directly to the company and whose mold sublimit is above 0.00 has a coverage limit of 50 percent (the pending allowance percentage) of that mold sublimit, rounded to the cent, half up; every other job, including one whose arrangement pays the carrier's proceeds to the insured, has a coverage limit of 0.00.

| Claim file status | Arrangement accepts direct carrier payments | Mold sublimit | Coverage limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Approved | Yes | Any | The mold sublimit |
| Estimate submitted | Yes | Above 0.00 | 50 percent of the mold sublimit, rounded to the cent, half up |
| Estimate submitted | Yes | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Approved or estimate submitted | No (proceeds paid to the insured) | Any | 0.00 |
| Any other status, or no linked claim file | — | — | 0.00 |

The mold-covered charges are the job's remediation scope, equipment day and clearance fee lines.

Hypothetical: an estimate submitted file on an arrangement accepting direct payment, with a mold sublimit of 3125.00, gives a coverage limit of 1562.50.
